name: mongoose
description: mongoose 8 over xisto's mongodb driver: ObjectId, Schema (paths, indexes, options), Connection (createConnection, server selection, readyState, events, useDb, db.command), models with find/findOne/findById/countDocuments/exists/distinct/create/insertMany/updateOne/updateMany/findOneAndUpdate/findOneAndDelete/deleteOne/deleteMany/aggregate/bulkWrite, filters and documents cast by the schema (defaults, timestamps, __v), autoCreate/autoIndex. Documents are objects of T with the fields T declares.
